text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ "JBC Classic."
A race mixing Classic and Senior tier runners,
regarded as the battle to crown the king of regional dirt tracks.

The first half of the GⅠ campaign running from October to December.
Therefore, Classic-class Umamusume who haven't fully matured yet are at a slight disadvantage...

"The gap between us and our seniors, Hokko Tarumae
and Wonder Acute, is still wide.
I wanted to hold off on facing them until December, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It may indeed be too early of a challenge.
The racecourse lies to the northeast, and the compass foretells hardship.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think there's value in knowing what the higher level is like.
Even if it feels totally out of reach at first glance...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The ki hasn't risen enough yet.
The solar term is Ritto—the beginning of winter.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Both Tarumae and Acute-san are preparing for December with energy to spare.
—That is what their omens show.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Winning or losing aside, now's the time for a quick spar.
Don't you think so, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're right, why not give it a shot?
Yeah, let's take on the challenge.

text_block_list.text:
And thus, the young Azure Dragon—from the east of the Bagua,
finally plunges amidst the glittering stars.

"How well we can run against the top two
is something we won't know until we try."
